what_changed: CFPB applies TILA ability-to-repay and disclosure rules to residential PACE financing (12 CFR 1026.35, 1026.37, 1026.38, 1026.41, 1026.43 and commentary).
rationale: PACE financing is a real-property tax-assessment product governed by mortgage-side Regulation Z provisions; excluded. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
